primary_hypothesis: The fixed exponential acquisition rule achieves exact constraint-graph recovery by600boards in at least90percent of independently sampled fresh source banks.
primary_effect: k/64, where k is the number of exponential N600 learned supports exactly equal to the810-edge true graph.
primary_interval: Exact binomial one-sided95percent Clopper-Pearson lower and upper limits,computed by binary inversion of finite binomial tails. Supported if lower>=.90 (requires at least62/64 exact); falsified if upper<.90; otherwise inconclusive. The two one-sided limits are each95percent,not a95percent two-sided interval.
uncertainty_limit: 64independent pseudorandom source-bank draws from the same finite eligible pool,without replacement within each bank; cross-bank overlap permitted and reported. Binomial interpretation assumes independent draws and independent tie streams. This is a recovery-probability confirmation,not a superiority test.
policies: Uniform and candidate use unchanged online_policy.py. Exponential uses unchanged exponential_policy.py selected by the prespecified H1v rule: choose exponential if10percentNI supported; otherwise mixture. H1v supported NI. Fixed weight(8/9)^m before first equality,zero afterward; fixed25querygreedy and unchanged tie rule. No rate tuning.
rng: For bank s in0..31, NumPy2.3.4 default_rng(20261125+s).permutation(81) once per row, shared across policies. Shadowcurrent-row permutations RNG20261225+s. This is unchanged tie logic; banks0..5 reuse prior tie seeds but have wholly new raw boards.
acquisition_interface: Policy receives only past joint/equal counts, k=25 and tie order. It has no file access, row solutions, current values, source identifiers, geometry or oracle handle. The harness fixes and records the mask before revealing only its25 queried values. Full stored completions act solely as the simulated label oracle.
gates: All current-row masks finalize before reveal; premature reveal rejected. State unchanged by selection. For every row/policy, permuting hidden current-row values leaves the finalized mask identical. Observed files contain values only at selected cells. Independent recount of all prefix supports and exact25-query count.
secondary: N300/450/600/1000 exact-recovery and extra-edge curves are descriptive. Evaluate all192 N600 policy/bank-seed cells on fresh full-all[200000,210000), exact support/settings/seed/input dedup permitted. Accuracy contrasts candidate-uniform,exponential-uniform,exponential-candidate use paired two-way bootstrap95percent intervals,5000draws,RNG20261301,descriptive and unadjusted.
budget: At most30GPU-minutes, including bounded preflight/validation. CPU acquisition and overlapping preparation/search are eligible; no filler GPU work.
limitations: Active acquisition is simulated from stored complete boards; the policy itself sees only queried labels.
25 queries per board fixes label cost. Policies can expose different digits from the same current row, then learn from their different histories.
Adaptive masks are not independent uniform draws, so the previous independent-mask coverage theorem does not directly apply.
BP AdamW is outside this count-energy acquisition mechanism study and is not run.
The exponential and mixture scores are heuristics; their model assumptions are not asserted to hold for Sudoku.
Cross-bank source-row overlap is permitted by independent sampling; unique input count is reported.
N600 recovery success is not a claim of superiority over candidate acquisition.
Identical graph energies reuse inference only when seed,cohort and complete settings also match. Same10000inferencepuzzles repeat across64bank/search seeds.
relation_to_prior: Independent confirmation after exploratory target feasibility on six previously used banks. Pilot is not pooled. Candidate and exponential both recovered6/6 atN600,so primary does not claim superiority.
stopping_rule: Exactly64independent banks of1000boards,threefixed policies,fourconstructioncheckpoints and192requestedN600inferencecells except exact dedup. No adaptive extension.
heuristic_scope: Fixed exponential scores are an acquisition heuristic,not calibrated posterior probabilities.
registration_rule: Full study and sampling protocols freeze before input generation. After preparation, an immutable registration records the input manifest SHA256 and unchanged study protocol SHA256 before acquisition. Runners resolve the manifest hash from that registration; no outcomes are available during registration.
